descricao: As much as people have explored them, essentially nothing is known about the mechanism in which they are made or when they began to form. They like to document anomalies, forgetting completely that the very ground they tread on is anomalous in nature. Like every human born, the Backrooms can also exist with aberrations, mutations. Somewhere in the twisted macrocosm of this foul universe is a graveyard. Not one composed of corpses, mind you it is a sinking mire of malformed walls and unfinished thoughts.
